## Details
### **SW-REQ-TIME-001** — Monotonic Microsecond Time Source

- **Description:** The time library shall provide a monotonic time value expressed in microseconds since FSW startup.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-026; a monotonic microsecond counter is the canonical FSW time base for all records.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-026
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TIME-002** — Non-Decreasing Time Values

- **Description:** The time library shall return time values that never decrease between successive queries.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-026 and SW-REQ-SYS-044; monotonicity is the deterministic property the system depends on.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TIME-003** — Sixty-Four-Bit Counter Width

- **Description:** The time library shall represent the monotonic time value using a 64-bit unsigned integer.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-026; 64-bit width prevents wrap during the FT1 mission and any plausible future mission.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-026
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TIME-004** — Per-Call Time Query Interface

- **Description:** The time library shall provide an interface returning the current monotonic time value on each call.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-027; per-record timestamping requires callers to query time at each sample event.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-027
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TIME-005** — Bounded Query Latency

- **Description:** The time library shall return from a time query without blocking on I/O or scheduling.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044; cheap and deterministic time queries keep the TDM scheduler loop predictable.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TIME-006** — POSIX Implementation Functional Equivalence

- **Description:** The time library shall provide a POSIX implementation functionally equivalent to the Pico2 implementation.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; Trick simulation requires POSIX builds that exercise the same time API as flight.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TIME-007** — Pico2 Implementation for Flight Hardware

- **Description:** The time library shall provide a Pico2 implementation returning monotonic microseconds from the on-board hardware time base.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; flight hardware build requires a Pico2 implementation paired with the POSIX implementation.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
